name: Capital One Venture X Rewards Credit Card

intro_offer.headline: 75,000 bonus miles
intro_offer.spend_requirement: $4,000 in purchases in the first 3 months

rewards.on: hotels and rental cars booked through Capital One Travel
flights booked through Capital One Travel

regular_apr: 19.99% to 29.99% variable, depending on your credit
rating_reason: The $300 annual Capital One Travel credit and 10,000 anniversary miles (worth $100) make the effective cost close to zero for anyone who books any travel in a year. The flat 2x on everything means you never have to think about categories. Good alternative to Sapphire Reserve if you spend more on everyday purchases than on dining.
best_for: people who book at least one trip a year and want a simple 2x on everything else
heavy travelers who want lounge access without the Amex or Chase ecosystem
skip_if: you book travel infrequently and would not use the $300 Capital One Travel credit; without it, the math does not work
